largestMaterialFinding.title: An empty native journal grants replay permission to an already in-flight custom tool
largestMaterialFinding.criterion: Approved SPEC0224 section 3.2: without settlement proof or recoverable result, handoff/uncertainty, never replay.

sourceAnchors.detail: The no-replay guard checks native descriptor provenance, not an existing operation settlement record.
An absent operation becomes a fresh RESERVED record.
Recovery enters reserve; fresh reservation passes the checks and reaches tool.execute at line 362.
Optional native journal wraps compatibility custom tools on composition/recreation.

preconditions: Public complete mode, compatibility tools port, acknowledged V2 pending CALL_TOOL checkpoint and its original TOOL/RUNNING step.
The first synthetic body has incremented a memory counter and has no completed result.
Recreate the public harness with the same tool ID/version/input and a fresh InMemoryEffectJournal whose get(tenant,operationKey) is null.
Case none: the initial custom invocation had no journal; case factory: the initial invocation used a separate native journal whose pre-body record is not present in the recreated journal.
largestMaterialFinding.impact: The original unresolved invocation is replayed without prior native settlement proof, and the new journal confirms only the second invocation. Two actual body entries remain accounted as one tool call.
largestMaterialFinding.repro: authority-gap.test.ts (cases none and factory); focused-authority-gap.command.json; authority-gap-observed.json
largestMaterialFinding.boundedCorrection: An existing in-flight recovery must require native reconciliation/settlement evidence before invoking the executor; native wrapper provenance alone is insufficient. Keep fresh initial dispatch and recovery of confirmed recoverable output usable. No journal schema redesign is proposed.
largestMaterialFinding.limits: This requires absent journal history on recreation or adding a fresh journal to an unjournaled custom-tool recovery. It does not reproduce against the same retained native journal with EFFECT_STARTED or CONFIRMED history. No external side effect or actual OS-process restart was performed.

criteria.evidence: provided two RUNNING/FAILED cases plus independent two repeated-recovery cases; one body, TOOL_FAILURE, exact checkpoint preserved
provided initial invocation plus independent NONE/READ/WRITE/EXTERNAL controls complete with one body and no model call
factory and prewrapped controls retain EFFECT_STARTED and block another body
factory and prewrapped controls recover exact journal-origin object including Unicode/U+0000; one body, one tool call, zero model/token/cost usage; journal record unchanged
unjournaled handoff checkpoint exact, returned token/cost/call usage conserved; confirmed result retained in complete envelope; empty-journal cases run two bodies while toolCalls remains one
user text, idempotent=true, string flags and two caller-created lookalike symbols did not authorize unjournaled replay
both compositions still evaluate native policy; DENY returns POLICY_DENIED; required approval returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED; confirmed journal remains unchanged

all four existing journal value exports callable; all five journal type exports explicitly retained at index.ts:21; internal hasNativeEffectJournal absent from public entrypoint; no typecheck performed
I1-R4-F01: two failing adversarial tests, original acknowledged checkpoint and all original pre-body steps preserved, get() null before recovery; second body with same operationKey and COMPLETED

preservedObserverDraft.cause: Incorrect test assumptions, not candidate defects: second execution after COMPLETED is STATE_CONFLICT; pending approval is APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Corrected after reading actual source contract; no candidate changes.
